title: [3.x] Fix `GLES3` padding uniforms so they match
body:
Fixes regression from #123652 :

```
ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Program LINK FAILED:
error: definitions of uniform block `DirectionalLightData' do not match
```

## Notes
* Copypasta error by yours truly when copying from the original PR :blush: 
* Vertex and Fragment shader blocks need to match, #123652 only copied the change into the vertex shader, but missed making the corresponding change in the fragment shader.
